coupling_convention: f_a in GeV vs m_a in eV; excluded band 1.6e16 < f_a < 1e18 GeV for m_a below 1e-11 eV
notes: Constraint on axion-nuclear coupling parametrized via decay constant f_a from BNS inspiral GW170817. Excludes 1.6e16 GeV < f_a < 1e18 GeV for axion masses below 1e-11 eV at 3sigma. The paper's exclusion is a band in the m_a-f_a plane (Fig.1), so AxionMass is appropriate. The four points bound the excluded rectangle (m_a from ~1e-13 to 1e-11 eV, f_a from 1.6e16 to 1e18 GeV).
